incidents.title: Singapore finance director sends US$499K after deepfake Zoom call
incidents.outcome: About US$499K transferred; recovered by Singapore and Hong Kong police when the scammers asked for another US$1.4M.
incidents.confidenceReason: Singapore Police Force statement, relayed by Mothership, says deepfakes impersonated executives.
incidents.summary: After a WhatsApp approach posing as the CFO, the finance director joined a Zoom with deepfaked executives and moved funds to a mule account. Police traced and froze the money.
incidents.quote: Finance director in S'pore transfers S$670,000 to scammers who used deepfake to impersonate company's executives

harness.note: Deepfake/impersonation tool only, no agent harness

incidents.title: Fraudulent prompts via the AIXBT dashboard make an AI trading agent transfer 55.5 ETH
incidents.targets: AIXBT autonomous agent (Simulacrum wallet), about US$106,200
incidents.confidenceReason: The agent's operators described the compromise; it reaches us through the AI Incident Database.
incidents.summary: An attacker got into the AIXBT agent's dashboard and queued fraudulent prompts that made the AI trading agent transfer 55.5 ETH.
incidents.quote: The attacker is reported to have infiltrated the secure dashboard of the AIXBT autonomous system at 2:00 AM UTC on March 18, 2025, and allegedly queued two fraudulent prompts that instructed the AI agent to transfer funds from its simulacrum wallet.
incidents.singleSourceReason: This operation reaches the ledger only through AI Incident Database's record; the 2026-11-17 sweep found no other publisher.

incidents.title: Hive0137 on an AI journey
incidents.confidenceReason: X-Force believes it likely that the emails are LLM-written; its own hedge.
incidents.summary: IBM X-Force, which follows Hive0137's phishing operations, believes the group's current campaign emails are likely created with LLMs. The date is approximate.
incidents.quote: After continuously following Hive0137 phishing operations, X-Force believes it is likely that the emails used in current Hive0137 campaigns are being created using Large Language Models (LLMs)
incidents.singleSourceReason: Only IBM X-Force has reported this operation among the sources found in the 2026-11-17 sweep.

incidents.title: Actor used Claude to build scrapers for leaked IoT camera credentials
incidents.outcome: Account banned; Anthropic could not confirm successful deployment.
incidents.confidenceReason: Anthropic investigated and banned the account but states deployment was unconfirmed.
incidents.summary: The actor used Claude to rewrite scraping tooling and process leaked usernames and passwords tied to security cameras, aiming to gain forced access to them.
incidents.quote: An actor leveraged Claude to enhance systems for identifying and processing exposed usernames and passwords associated with security cameras, while simultaneously collecting information on internet-facing targets to test these credentials against.
incidents.singleSourceReason: Only Anthropic has reported this operation among the sources found in the 2026-11-17 sweep.

harness.note: AI used as a chatbot/assistant, no agent harness
